name: plus_eq_add
prelude:
def plus : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | n, 0 => n
  | n, m + 1 => plus n m + 1
statement: theorem plus_eq_add (n m : Nat) : plus n m = n + m
proofs:
induction m with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih => rw [plus, ih, Nat.add_assoc]
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [plus]
  | succ m ih => simp only [plus, ih]; omega
